exercicio.statement:
Are 1/3 and 4/12 equivalent fractions? Mark 1/3 on Line 1 and mark 4/12 on Line 2 to find the answer.
Are they the same? Correct the equal sign.

steps.instruction: Use the model to represent 1/3 as a fraction less than one.
Interact with Line 1 to read the marked value.
Set Line 2 to have the number of equal parts needed for 4/12.
Enter 12 in the Line 2 denominator field and confirm it.
Mark the point for 4/12 on Line 2.
Compare the two marked positions on the number lines.
Enter the numerator of the equivalent fraction with denominator 12.
Select the comparison sign that shows the two fractions have the same value.
Press Done to finish the equivalent-fraction identification.
